scripts.check: corepack pnpm --dir frontend check && corepack pnpm --dir desktop check
scripts.quality:quick: corepack pnpm comments:check && corepack pnpm backend:check && corepack pnpm check
scripts.quality: corepack pnpm quality:quick && corepack pnpm backend:test
scripts.backend:check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format --check backend; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check backend; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format --check --config backend\pyproject.toml scripts; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check --config backend\pyproject.toml scripts; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m pyright --project backend"
scripts.backend:format: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format backend; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check --fix backend; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff format --config backend\pyproject.toml scripts; & (Resolve-Path 'backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe').Path -m ruff check --config backend\pyproject.toml --fix scripts"
